name: Neuralk Seldon API
description: Model-serving platform with a small trial allowance.
overview: Neuralk exposes Seldon-hosted models through an API with trial credits. Default predictions are memory-only and discarded, but the optional upload mode retains datasets for up to 90 days and the public terms do not settle training rights for every mode.
notes: Upload mode retains datasets for up to 90 days.
